body.text: ERPNext for trading companies brings purchasing, multi-warehouse stock, price lists, customer credit and accounts into one system, so traders and distributors know exactly what they have, what it cost and who owes them money. Teknoppy sets it up for wholesalers, importers and distributors across Kerala, India and the GCC.

paragraphs.text: Trading margins are thin, so small errors in stock, pricing or credit hurt quickly. ERPNext puts every purchase, sale, transfer and payment in one place, with no licence fee per user. A typical trading setup goes live in 6–10 weeks for a single company and 10–16 weeks for groups with several branches or countries.
Traders choose ERPNext for trading companies for five reasons:

items.html: 1. Accurate stock across every warehouse, branch and van
2. True landed cost, including freight, duty and clearing charges
3. Controlled credit, with alerts or blocks when customers go over their limit
4. Flexible pricing, with customer-wise price lists and discount rules
5. One set of books, updated the moment goods move

outro.text: As ERPNext trading software, it replaces the mix of billing tools, Excel sheets and accounting packages that most growing traders end up with.

sections.h2: Signs Your Trading Business Has Outgrown Its Tools

items.text: Stock in the system rarely matches the warehouse
Margins are calculated in Excel after the month ends
Salespeople give prices from memory or old lists
Overdue customers keep getting new deliveries
Each branch keeps its own records and sends them by email

outro.text: If three or more sound familiar, ERPNext for trading companies usually recovers its cost through better margins and faster collections within the first year.

paragraphs.text: ERPNext warehouse management tracks quantity and value in each warehouse, branch, showroom and delivery van. Stock transfers between locations are recorded with the person, date and vehicle, so nothing disappears in transit.

ERPNext inventory for trading also supports batches with expiry dates, serial numbers, multiple units of measure and barcode scanning. Reorder levels raise purchase requests automatically, and stock ageing reports show slow-moving items before they become dead stock.

sections.h2: Price Lists, Discounts and Customer Credit

paragraphs.text: Most traders sell the same item at different prices to dealers, retailers and walk-in customers. ERPNext stores separate price lists for each group, and pricing rules apply discounts by quantity, season or customer, without manual overrides.

Credit control is built in. Each customer has a credit limit and payment terms. When a new order would push them over the limit, ERPNext warns the salesperson or blocks the order until a manager approves it. Overdue reports by customer and salesperson help your collections team chase the right accounts first. Payment reminders can go out by email or WhatsApp on a schedule, so customers are nudged before an invoice becomes seriously overdue.
Getting pricing and credit right is often the biggest win when moving to ERPNext for trading companies, because it protects margin on every invoice.

ERPNext for importers handles purchases in USD, EUR, AED or any currency, posted at the correct exchange rate. Freight, customs duty, clearing and insurance are added to the cost of the goods in that shipment, so your stock value and margins reflect what the items really cost.

ERPNext for import export business owners also get shipment tracking against purchase orders and export documents in the right currency. ERPNext for exporters supports packing lists, multi-currency invoices and bank realisation tracking.

ERPNext order management follows each order from quotation to delivery and payment. Partial deliveries, back orders and returns are all tracked against the original order. Damaged or returned goods go to a separate warehouse, so they never appear as sellable stock.

For field sales, salespeople can create orders on a phone or tablet, and managers see targets and performance by person and region. ERPNext dealer management handles dealer price lists, schemes and outstanding balances. For ERPNext for B2B distributors that deliver on fixed routes, we set up route-wise delivery lists and collection tracking.
This is where ERPNext distribution management pays off: orders, stock, delivery and collections all update one record.

As an ERPNext trading company India-wide partner, we set up GST, e-way bills and multi-state branches correctly from the start.

paragraphs.html: Gulf traders get VAT-ready setups, re-export documents and AED, SAR or QAR accounting. ERPNext for trading companies in the Gulf also needs Arabic invoices, which we design as standard. See ERPNext implementation in the GCC.

items.a: Yes. Each warehouse, branch, showroom or van can be its own stock location. Transfers between them are recorded, and reports show quantity and value per location or across the whole business.

items.q: Can it add import costs to stock?
items.a: Yes. Freight, customs duty, clearing and insurance can be added to the items in each shipment, so your stock value and margins reflect the real cost.

items.q: Does it support customer credit limits?
items.a: Yes. Each customer can have a credit limit and payment terms. ERPNext warns or blocks new orders that go over the limit until a manager approves them.

items.q: Is ERPNext good for small traders?
items.a: Yes. ERPNext for traders has no licence fee per user, so small businesses can start with billing, stock and accounts, then add field sales and approvals later. Many go live in 6–8 weeks.

items.q: How long does it take to move a trading business to ERPNext?
items.a: A single company with one or two warehouses usually goes live in 6–10 weeks. Groups with several branches, currencies or companies take 10–16 weeks. Setting up ERPNext for trading companies in phases keeps billing running every day of the project.

items.q: Can salespeople take orders on mobile?
items.a: Yes. Salespeople can check stock, create orders and record collections on a phone or tablet, and managers see the results immediately.

items.q: How does ERPNext help with stock and purchase planning?
items.a: ERPNext stock management for traders uses reorder levels, lead times and sales history to suggest what to buy. ERPNext sales and purchase management keeps orders, deliveries and supplier bills linked, so buyers order the right quantity at the right time.
